g.text: Large-event fits and predictions: Mp and Mw together
Six measured-ML>4 events in five families; all methods use identical NW2 targets. The two large Gyeongju events require extrapolation in their held-out fold.
Labels 1–6: 2015-12-21, 2016-09-12, 2016-09-19, 2019-07-21, 2023-11-29 and 2024-06-11 (UTC). Few independent large families limit generalization.
